spec.template: A wide establishing shot of a modern city skyline in clear daylight. Distant buildings and a rooftop antenna. Slow camera pan. No people visible. Realistic live-action cinematography.

A medium frontal shot of A young adult East Asian man with short black hair, wearing a {{hero.costume}} jacket over a plain white T-shirt. He stands on a rooftop in clear daylight and slowly turns toward the camera. His upper body and the entire jacket remain clearly visible throughout the shot. Neutral natural lighting, realistic live-action cinematography, stable camera.

An empty outdoor concrete staircase leading to a rooftop exit. A green metal door and yellow handrail in clear daylight. Slow forward camera movement. No people visible. Realistic live-action cinematography.

A medium three-quarter side shot of A young adult East Asian man with short black hair, wearing a {{hero.costume}} jacket over a plain white T-shirt. He walks slowly along a rooftop beside a low concrete wall in clear daylight. The camera tracks beside him. His upper body and jacket remain clearly visible. Neutral natural lighting, realistic live-action cinematography.
A wide shot of a steel bridge with moving cars above a river in clear daylight. The camera is stationary. No pedestrians visible. Realistic live-action cinematography.

A medium frontal shot of A young adult East Asian man with short black hair, wearing a {{hero.costume}} jacket over a plain white T-shirt. He stops beside a rooftop ventilation unit, then turns his head toward the camera. Clear daylight. His upper body and jacket remain clearly visible throughout. Neutral natural lighting, realistic live-action cinematography, stable camera.
